years.reason: Abnormal year: confirmed paper leak, 1,563 grace-mark cases and a re-test, a physics answer-key revision (about 4 lakh candidates lost 5 marks), 720-scorers fell from 67 to 17. Excluded from curve fitting; counts kept for cross-checks only (plan §3.3).
notes: 2024 appeared: highlights table says 2,333,297; the 2024 breakdown tables total 2,333,162 (135 apart).

years.marksToAirBasis: KEA 2025: every Karnataka claimant's AIR and score (official). For each mark: airFirst..airLast = lowest..highest AIR seen at that mark; air = their midpoint. AIR is all-India, so this is the all-India curve sampled.

Official NTA points only: 39 'marks at selected ranks' anchors, score-band floors (cumulative count from the top = AIR of the last candidate at that floor) and the press-release counts (715: 2, >=650: 1,492, >=600: 10,160, >=500: 90,780).
notes: 2026 was a re-exam (21/06/2026) after the 03/05/2026 exam was cancelled for a paper leak; 2.8 lakh registered candidates were absent. Weight it with 2025, never alone (plan §3.3, §5).

expected2027.formula: registered 2026 (2,279,743) x 2025 attendance (2,209,318/2,276,069 = 0.9707) = 2,212,884, rounded to 0.1 lakh; not 2026's re-exam-depressed 1,999,895
